card.name: Space after drug name before dose
card.fires_on: The space right after a drug name when a dose amount such as 200 mg is about to follow. It appears in drug-interaction and dosing sentences.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: A blank space after a drug name, just before a number and mg.
modes.example: concomitant treatment with fluconazole<< >>200 mg once daily and cis

modes.label: Drug name then verb
modes.description: Occasionally a word right after a drug name, such as were, where a measurement or result follows.
modes.example: Lower exposures of rilpivirine<< were>> observed during pregnancy
